sources.name: Stats NZ - Household Labour Force Survey estimated working-age population: June 2024 quarter
sources.assumptions: 4,316,000 - the usually resident, non-institutionalised, civilian population of New Zealand aged 15 years and over (June 2024 quarter). Used here as a stand-in for 'adults' generally, since Stats NZ doesn't publish a simple 18+ headline figure the way it does for the labour force's 15+ working-age population - this slightly overstates true 18+ adults (it includes 15-17 year olds) and doesn't exclude the small institutionalised population that would still be UBI-eligible. Used as the recipient count for the income tax panel's UBI slider (amount x recipients = government expenditure).
